biotools.summary: This BioExcel Building Blocks library (biobb) workflow sets up and runs a molecular dynamics simulation of a protein for each mutation in a given list, using GROMACS. For every mutation it fixes the structure, models the mutated residue, builds the topology, solvates the system, adds ions, minimises the energy, equilibrates (NVT and NPT) and runs a short production simulation, followed by basic analyses (energy, radius of gyration, RMSd). The example used is the Lysozyme protein (PDB code 1AKI).
